title: Circle Free Convex Bodies Under Minkowski Addition
statement: If $K$ is a circle-free convex body in $\mathbb{R}^3$ and $B$ is a ball, is the Minkowski sum $K+B$ also circle-free?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Discrete Geometry (2012), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2011/44, pp. 2459--2548](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2011/44)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The Minkowski-sum circle-free question is stated as a problem; known results for planar sets and special bodies do not settle arbitrary circle-free convex bodies.

- [original OWR report](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2011/44)
